description: Election Commission - Mr. P. Piyasena of the Nivitigala Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of Member of that P. S.
reasoning: This gazette notice announces that a member of the Nivitigala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes as it deals with the status of an elected local government official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing vacancy declarations in local authorities.
